title: Bar Salts Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Menthol from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts collection delivers exactly what it promises—a straightforward, invigorating and endlessly refreshing Menthol experience. From the first inhale, a cooling wave wraps your senses, offering a pure and simple pleasure that's refreshingly uncomplicated. This exquisite e-liquid proves that sometimes less really is more, with its singular focus on delivering a consistently cooling vape. You may have tried Menthol flavours before, but few can match the clean, crisp refreshment of the astonishing arctic rush of Bar Salts' Menthol e-juice. For fans of menthol who are ready to move beyond disposables, this 10ml nic salt e-liquid is your reliable, go-to option. If you’ve adored similar flavours found in disposable vapes, then you’ll absolutely swoon for Menthol from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection of 10ml Nic Salt e-liquids with non-disposable vapes. This premium e-liquid boasts a 50VG/50PG ratio, expertly balancing flavour and vapour. Perfect for starter kits and pod systems, its nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth, gratifying throat hit—especially ideal for those fresh off cigarettes. Nicotine Salt E-liquids are absorbed swiftly, making them a great choice for immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Looking for something a bit different? Check out the Bar Salts collection by Vampire Vape, featuring many other exciting flavours like Cherry Ice, Blue Sour Raspberry and Pineapple Ice. These 10ml e-liquids can be used in starter kits and pod kits and they allow you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer than a 2ml disposable vape device, all while reducing plastic waste. And because they share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable cousins, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver all the satisfying relief from nicotine cravings along with a super-smooth throat hit for comfortable, effective and enjoyable all-day vaping.
